links.outcome: Diagnostic prediction accuracy of LLM with versus without knowledge graph retrieved paths
links.effect: DR.KNOWS with KG paths showed higher accuracy in extracting diagnostic concepts and improved diagnostic prediction metrics over QuickUMLS, T5 and ChatGPT baselines; prompt-tuned T5 with KG paths achieved highest ROUGE-L and CUI F1.
links.quote: Prompt-based fine-tuning of Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer with DR.KNOWS knowledge paths achieved the highest ROUGE-L (Recall-Oriented Understudy for Gisting Evaluation-Longest Common Subsequence) and concept unique identifier F<sub>1</sub>-scores, highlighting the benefits of KG integration.

unlisted_practices: Integrating UMLS-based knowledge graph path retrieval into LLMs to improve diagnostic reasoning

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates DR.KNOWS, which tests adding structured knowledge graph retrieval grounding to standard LLMs (T5 and ChatGPT) to improve diagnostic prediction accuracy and clinical safety rationales on EHR datasets.
